The attendees listed in the minutes include Karin Lindqvist, Anders Holm, Sofia Berg, and Erik Nyström, with apologies from Johan Wahl and Lena Ekdahl [1].

items.question: What happens to undisputed amounts paid late under the MSA?
items.answer: Under the Harrowgate MSA, undisputed amounts not paid when due accrue interest at one percent (1%) per month until paid [1].

evidence.quote: Undisputed amounts not paid when due accrue interest at one percent (1%) per month until paid.

items.question: Is liability for breach of confidentiality limited by the MSA's cap?
items.answer:
The MSA's liability cap applies to the total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with the Agreement, and it is capped at USD 250,000 or the Fees paid by the Client in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim [1].

However, the documents also mention that the board authorised the renewal of the MSA provided that the liability cap is not reduced below USD 400,000 [3].

Therefore, the liability for breach of confidentiality is subject to the liability cap, but the specific amount may be higher depending on the terms of the renewal. The documents do not specify whether the cap was actually increased to USD 400,000.

evidence.quote: total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of USD 250,000 or the Fees paid by Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
liability cap is not reduced below USD 400,000

items.question: How can the engagement with Calder & Wynne be ended?
items.answer:
The engagement with Calder & Wynne can be ended by either party giving written notice. According to the engagement letter, either party may end the engagement at any time by written notice, and the client will pay for work done up to that point [2].

There is no mention of any other specific conditions for termination in the engagement letter itself. However, the Harrowgate MSA outlines termination for convenience with 30 days' notice, but it is unclear if this applies to the engagement with Calder & Wynne [3].
